content.text: RBI Grade B (DR) applications for Panel Year 2026 ran from

. Our values are checked against Appendix-I of the official RBI notice (Advt. No. RBISB/DA/01/2026-27). The photo and signature specs match the standard bank portal. The notice also fixes the KB limits for the
, but not their pixel sizes, so this page marks those two as disputed.

The Grade B notice lists one “preferred” size, 140×60 px, for the signature, thumb and declaration together. For the thumb and the declaration we use the pixel sizes that RBI’s own Assistant notice gives for the same form, 240×240 px and 800×400 px. The KB limits are exactly as printed. If the portal asks for a different pixel size, use the custom size option.
Download the RBI Grade B notice and open Appendix-I, part (D), on scanning and uploading.
Compare the four sizes with the list above. Note any difference.
Make the files here. For any size that differs, switch that document to custom size.
Write the declaration text exactly as printed in the notice. The text on this page is copied from it.
DR (General) and DEPR or DSIM use separate application links, and each needs its own fee. The uploads and their sizes are the same in every form, so you can reuse the same files.
Sign in your normal running hand, not capitals. Use the same signature on the exam day.
Use a stamp pad for the thumb; ballpoint ink rubbed on the thumb smudges.
Keep the declaration on unruled white paper with black ink.
The live photo taken in the form should match your uploaded photo.

If the thumb or declaration upload fails with a size error even though our Pass check is green, the portal wants a different pixel size. Read the size from the error message, switch that document to custom size, and fit it again.
